slides.title: A message from you, ten years from now
slides.body:
One sentence, sent to you today.
What does it say?

slides.title: Try it tonight (5 minutes)
slides.body:
1. Picture yourself ten years from now, clearly.
2. Write the one sentence they'd send you today.
3. Then write your reply.

Stuck? Start with: “The sentence would be…”

slides.title: Why it's worth five minutes
slides.body: Imagining your future self vividly makes it easier to make choices that are kind to them. And sometimes the sentence is gentler than you'd expect.

slides.title: Your future self's message, in 3 words?
slides.body: Write them in the comments. Save this for a quiet moment tonight.
